description: Bounded reference packet for the noncentral routed-seam campaign (issue #624). The hash-pinned #613 chain supplies the certified spherical federation, an order-six menu computed inside a declared axis coefficient system, and a measured binary-icosahedral extension witness. The axis relation lattice, a physical global form, and its same-source identification with the matter-action kernel remain unselected. The verifier proves exact gauge triviality for exactly coherent assignments on the pinned nerve and computes H2(S2,A)=A for each separately declared abelian central coefficient group. It does not derive centrality, classify arbitrary value groups, prove general order-six exhaustiveness, identify the V4 extension class with a spherical H2 class, or select a matter representation. Z6/Z7 candidates retain the pinned incidence nerve and pass reduced translation and uniform-state checks while emitting different typed coefficient-class counts; they do not instantiate the complete A1-A3 schema. The identity crossed module S3 to S3 admits raw noncentral labels but has contractible 2-type and emits no nontrivial sector. The complete axiom-level classification remains open. Four-dimensional instanton normalization, theta periodicity, and laboratory current lines remain separate gates.
